title: VideoScout: Learning Agentic Active Exploration with Adaptive Reasoning Pacing for Long Video Understanding

rs.key_step: 把视频采样变成连续evidence acquisition：speed/notes/rewatch/answer动作，先turnSFT再trajectoryDAPO。
rs.why_non_obvious: 把何时观察和何时答合并学习，但teacher timing只是示范代理不是最小充分证据时刻。
rs.trigger_condition: When a one-shot video scan misses sparse evidence, learn sequential viewing pace, memory, revisit and stopping actions.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When a one-shot video scan misses sparse evidence, learn sequential viewing pace, memory, revisit and stopping actions.

signatures.information: 当前clip、query、文本memory、teacher answerprogress/GT训练标签
signatures.operation: speed1/2/4x顺序读；局部rewatch；composite terminal reward训练
signatures.failure_boundary: rewatch仅最近fastwindow不能任意回早段；textmemory可积累错误；无audio；timing正确性门不保证policy精度不降。

relevance.how: 直接active视觉采样/SFT→RL机制可迁移crop。
RLonly崩塌显示先教行动空间与格式的重要性。
rewatch范围限制决定纠偏能力。
